
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /teach  (/t)                               │
  │  Teach Me Mode                              │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Toggle teach mode — adds explanations to every response.

  Usage:
    /teach
    /t

  Details:
    When teach mode is ON, RadSim adds [teach] inline annotations explaining
    what each piece of code does and why. Great for learning new
    languages, frameworks, or understanding unfamiliar codebases.
    
    Annotations appear in magenta and are automatically stripped
    from files written to disk.

  Examples:
    $ /teach
    $ /t

  Tips:
    Tip: Press T as a hotkey to toggle teach mode quickly
    Tip: Annotations are stripped from saved files automatically

  Related: /modes  /show
